description: R08 DeserializationTests profile collection seam: safe Rust owns user-first profile ordering, duplicate/default validation, hide/active projection, generated identity continuity, and global property layering for the Microsoft profile-collection contracts.

entries.notes: A non-empty profile collection loads; missing or empty effective profile lists fail with the migrated NoProfiles boundary.
defaultProfile resolves by GUID or profile name; an unresolved explicit default emits MissingDefaultProfile and falls back to the first effective profile.
Duplicate GUID identities retain their first user occurrence, emit one DuplicateProfile warning, and preserve the surviving order.
DuplicateProfile precedes MissingDefaultProfile in the warning sequence while the first surviving profile becomes the fallback default.
Inbox global values survive unless user settings override them; user initial rows/columns and tab-titlebar settings win independently.
User profile order is authoritative for matched/default profiles and unmatched inbox profiles append after all user entries.
AllProfiles retains hidden entries while ActiveProfiles filters them after user-first ordering.
Name-only profiles receive effective identity without disrupting user ordering or inherited default-profile reconciliation.
GUID-less user profiles coexist with explicit/default identities without crashes; matched inbox names survive omitted user names and ordering remains stable.
Generated identity distinguishes name-only profiles; distinct names remain independent and user entries precede unmatched inbox defaults.
A collection with at least one visible profile loads; an all-hidden effective collection fails with AllProfilesHidden.
